Gospel Toon character revision 2026-10-27

New original analytic sculpted head/eye/lid/hair geometry, materials, procedural
hair paint, shader and garment re-tailoring by this project. No commercial game
source code, executable, mesh or texture was extracted or reverse engineered.
References to Genshin/Trails describe a broad cel-shaded JRPG direction, not asset
origin, equivalence, permission or affiliation.

Retained licensed skeletal limbs, hands, feet, rig and locomotion source:
Quaternius Universal Base Characters Standard FREE and Universal Animation
Library Standard, CC0, as recorded in Tools/Art/Gospel3D/SOURCE-NOTICE.txt.

The input GospelActorsAuthored.blend and earlier sources remain preserved.
Natural MakeHuman heads/skin/hair in that input are removed by this new pipeline;
they are not the visual surface of the new rendered actors. The old resources
and their existing license/provenance files remain available for history.

The depictions are artistic educational reconstructions, not historical facial
likenesses. Blender preview approval is an internal prototype review only.
